violations.text: Salsas were observed held on ice at 45 degrees. Staff placed in refrigeration during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026
Menus are lacking an allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the service area and staff restroom. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

A drink stirrer was observed in the hand-washing sink in the service area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Multiple food items were observed held at 44-51 degrees Fahrenheit in double-stacked plastic containers in the prep units. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods that were held above 41 degrees for an undetermined period of time were discarded. Ice was added to containers to facilitate temperature control. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Establishment is using Time as a Public Health control for self-serve salsas and garnishes without prior written approval. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Carnitas was observed cooling on the counter in a covered plastic container greater than four inches deep. Staff placed carnitas on sheet pan to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. Inspector provided during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the slicer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener taken to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/20/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 05/04/2026
The auto-dispenser for the sanitizing solution was not dispensing at proper concentration. Establishment has quaternary ammonium tablets for use. New Violation. Correct By: 05/04/2026
